Scripts/Game/EXPBG/EBG_CDFAuthorRegistra.note: Changed in this repository: restored characters now receive the CDF author compensation (SetAuthor finds the CDF record itself because vanilla SCR_EditableCharacterComponent.EOnEditorSessionLoad skips super); a found record is never dropped; [EBG CDF AUTHORS] restore summary and per-frame summary of deletes whose author is not registered (0.1.3). That delete summary covers a 30 s window instead of one frame and names the window (0.1.8).

Scripts/Game/EXPBG/EBG_CDFCacheAdapter.c.note: Changed in this repository: [EBG CDF EMPTY GROUP(S)] diagnostic for CDF-guarded groups that end a restore without AI (members never saved vs failed to restore, Unit Caching snapshot present); [CDF TIMING] Restore and Apply timing; passes the document to the author restore summary (0.1.3). World cleanup cancels the pending unregistered-author delete summary and prints it at once (0.1.8).

origin.note: Byte-identical at aa08748de50e4b35839bed650951d3b00ff302f3 (the GM Tools intel-items source) and in the installed Workshop 0.0.4 data.pak.

Scripts/Game/EXPII/EII_CDFState.c.note: Changed in this repository: carried-Intel restore matching bounded per carrier (GUID buckets, one before/after inventory scan); Restore validation and prefab checks reused by Apply; [CDF TIMING] Restore and Apply timing (0.1.3). GM Tools server racks and USB drives saved and restored through an outer "eirIntel" envelope with its own rack/drive prefab whitelist (rack title, text, download seconds and diagnostics; drive intel in the world and in captured inventories; carried drives handled like carried Intel); records without the envelope load as before (0.1.4). Capture allocates nothing until it finds Intel, a rack or a drive, and walks a captured inventory once for carried Intel and carried drives (same records, order and refusals); the Intel, rack and drive whitelists skip their literal lists for any resource that is neither an 18-character GUID nor an /EXPII/ path (0.1.8).

Scripts/Game/EAD_CDF/EAD_CDF.c.note: Changed in this repository: a refused CDF load opens a dialog for the Game Master (0.1.2); [CDF TIMING] Restore and Apply timing, building replay counted as adapter time (0.1.3).

origin.note: Developed in this repository. Saves and loads EXPBG GM Tools garrisons (0.1.11 and later) in the CDF document through the GM Tools garrison ledger; replaces the 0.1.5 Full-cache guard.

Developed in this repository. Saves each Unit Dialog AI's speaker name, dialog lines and talking gesture in its CDF state and restores them through EUD_RestoreState; invalid dialog state is refused before CDF clears the scene.

Developed in this repository. A CDF load restores exactly the saved AI Global Skills settings (vanilla before the first saved module value; vanilla when the load restores no module), and a session save keeps each AI group's combat mode from before the EXPBG rules of engagement changed it.

Developed in this repository. Prisoners are session-only under CDF: they are left out of every CDF save, and a CDF load removes the prisoners whose squad CDF manages (recorded at surrender) and releases their interrogation points.
